name: Yodaka no Hakoniwa
source:
A story about a child who is loosely held captive by a young boy and somehow manages to get out.

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/10903]Novelgame[/url]]
translation:
一个孩子被一名少年不甚严密地关了起来，后来不知怎么又设法逃了出去。这就是这个故事。

［译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/10903]Novelgame[/url]］
